Temos mais de 500 lojas divididas em: lojas físicas, lojas nos principais supermercados, lojas móveis que circulam pelos condomínios em diversas cidades e também uma loja online para que os clientes comprem como, quando e onde quiser. O nosso papel é estar cada vez mais próximo dos nossos clientes, através de uma experiência de compra e consumo com qualidade, preço justo, ambiente de compra agradável, praticidade e segurança, alimentando o mundo com o que há de melhor. E tudo isso só acontece pois temos um grande diferencial: nossas pessoas, que colocam paixão em tudo o que fazem.

titulo: Instrutor de Treinamento Pós-Vendas Técnico (Rio de Janeiro)
local: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
descricao: A Volkswagen Group Services é uma empresa do Grupo Volkswagen, orientada para trabalhar para as empresas do Grupo em todo o mundo. Prestamos serviços nas áreas de logística, tecnologia, engenharia, qualidade, serviços comerciais, recursos humanos, comunicação e serviços administrativos e financeiros. Estamos direcionados para as atividades dos nossos clientes e assumimos a responsabilidade de realizá-las em seu nome. A Volkswagen Group Services foi fundada em abril de 2001, em Wolfsburg, na Alemanha, com o nome de AutoVision e foi renomeada Volkswagen Group Services em 2018. O novo nome reflete a orientação estratégica do Grupo, incluindo as suas marcas e empresas. Atualmente nós temos escritórios em sete localizações europeias. E em 2023, iniciamos a operação América do Sul, com nossa primeira sede no Brasil. Responsabilidades e atribuições Planejar, coordenar, desenvolver e acompanhar programas de treinamento de Produtos, Processos, Tecnologias e temas Comportamentais, destinados aos profissionais da Rede de Concessionários, mercado de importadores SAM e equipe de Instrutores; Levantar e alinhar demandas de treinamento junto às áreas de Vendas, áreas normativas, parceiros e clientes, desenvolvendo soluções e metodologias adequadas às necessidades identificadas; Desenvolver e aplicar treinamentos, TTTs e demais ações de capacitação, garantindo o atendimento às certificações e padrões globais da Marca, incluindo participação em TTT – Training the Trainer e eventos junto à matriz VW AG para disseminação de know-how à equipe; Participar do desenvolvimento da equipe de Instrutores, incluindo participação no recrutamento e seleção, programas de desenvolvimento, reuniões periódicas de follow-up, acompanhamento das aplicações e validação de treinamentos e comunicados personalizados; Planejar, desenvolver e executar eventos e treinamentos de lançamento de produtos, realizando interface e negociação com fornecedores, regionais e áreas internas para garantir os recursos necessários, como veículos, locais, hotéis, equipamentos, gráficas e estrutura para test drive; Participar de reuniões, fóruns e workshops relacionados a lançamentos, treinamentos e iniciativas da Academia, além de apresentar temas relevantes nas reuniões dos Gerentes Regionais de Vendas e desenvolver materiais gerenciais para esses fóruns; Gerenciar, em conjunto com Logística, a frota de veículos do departamento, incluindo a organização dos pedidos de veículos funcionais junto às áreas de Launching, Produção e Frota. Domínio do pacote Office, em especial Excel e Power Point. Conhecimento sobre as rotinas das concessionárias de veículos. CNH categoria B ativa. Disponibilidade para viagens e atuação em Jacarépagua. descricao: Description We are looking for motivated, customer-focused people who want to join our team as a Reliability Maintenance Engineering Manager. The Reliability Maintenance Engineering Manager is the site lead for all Engineering matters within a building. They are responsible for leading their team and building a culture of safety; for ensuring all statutory compliance requirements are followed to provide a safe working environment for all occupants of the building; for providing a high level of equipment availability to the General Manager or Site Leader and for working with the Global Engineering team to plan for future growth. They are also required to take part in network wide improvement initiatives and to implement standards created elsewhere in the network. Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network. Key job responsibilities Lead the team, own the annual reporting responsibilities for the team and mentor their direct reports who in turn develop the technicians within the team. Work with the site Safety, Environmental, Sustainability departments & Site Leadership to implement, record and audit Amazon and statutory compliance programs to provide a safe working environment for all staff. About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and related services, with over $150M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all outdoor home services - pest control, pool cleaning, window cleaning, and more. About Engineering At LawnStarter Our engineering team builds the platform that connects hundreds of thousands of homeowners with over 70,000 active service pros. We operate three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, HomeGnome) on shared infrastructure, and we're profitable and growing. Engineering here is fast - we ship constantly, we own our systems end-to-end, and we don't tolerate "not my problem." We have strong processes and existing engineering managers, so you're not building from scratch. You're raising the bar. The Role We're growing, and that means adding engineering leadership capacity to support new initiatives. You'll lead cross-functional delivery teams of 4-5 engineers, reporting to our Head of Engineering. Your job is to make sure your team ships reliably, grows professionally, and doesn't become a bottleneck as LawnStarter scales into new service verticals. This is a people-first role. If your identity as an EM is primarily technical - if you'd rather review architecture than develop an underperformer - this isn't the right fit. If you're the manager who knows what every person on your team needs to grow, who handles conflict directly, and who can articulate team performance in metrics, keep reading. What Makes This Role Different You'll own both delivery AND people outcomes - neither can be delegated Distributed team across time zones, so async leadership and written communication matter as much as meetings We move fast and actually ship - you'll feel the difference between a team that's humming and one that's stuck AI-forward is not a buzzword here - we expect you to lead your team on how to use it, not just follow along What You'll Own People development: Concrete growth plans for every IC on your team - not just the struggling ones. You know where each person is going and what it takes to get there Delivery: Your team ships on cadence with predictable quality. You surface risk early, manage scope, and don't miss commitments without warning Team health: Conflict gets addressed directly. Underperformers are managed with a clear process. Top performers are protected and developed Cross-functional partnership: You're the interface between your team and Product, Design, and other engineering teams. Decisions get made, not stalled Technical direction: Close enough to the work to weigh in on system design and catch architectural risks. Not so close that you're in the weeds instead of removing blockers AI adoption: You're actively introducing AI tools and workflows into how your team operates - code review, documentation, sprint planning, debugging. You set the pace, not follow it Problems to Solve Building people leadership depth as the team scales LawnStarter is expanding into new service verticals quickly. That means new headcount, new complexity, and more pressure on EMs to develop the next generation of senior engineers and tech leads - not just ship features. We need an EM who's done this before, not one who's figuring it out. Managing distributed teams without losing culture or accountability Our engineering team spans multiple time zones and countries. Async communication, remote 1:1s, and distributed sprint ceremonies are the norm - not a workaround. An EM who needs daily in-person proximity to lead effectively won't thrive here. Turning delivery consistency into a competitive advantage We have product-market fit and real momentum. The constraint now is shipping reliably enough to compound on that momentum. Your team's velocity and predictability directly affects LawnStarter's ability to launch new services and capture market share. Orchestrating cross-functional delivery from roadmap to release An EM here is the connective tissue between Product, Design, and specialist functions - quality engineering, architecture, and security - from estimation through delivery. The hard part isn't running any one of those conversations well; it's running all of them in parallel without becoming the bottleneck they route through. We need an EM who can hold business value and technical soundness in view at once and make the tradeoff calls - not one who stalls when Product wants speed, Security wants rigor, and Architecture wants the durable answer. Turning AI adoption into throughput without sacrificing craftsmanship We're not experimenting with AI on the margins. Claude Code, spec-driven development, and AI-assisted review are becoming default workflows here - and we track adoption seriously. We need an EM who can turn "the team uses AI" into measurable throughput without letting quality slip, with real opinions about where AI helps and where it quietly creates debt. What Success Looks Like (Year 1) Every engineer on your team has a documented growth plan within 60 days - and you can speak to it from memory Your team ships its committed scope on cadence within 90 days Zero surprise departures - you know your retention risks and are actively working them Underperformance is addressed directly and documented, not deferred The Head of Engineering trusts your team's commitments because you've proven they're reliable Your team is visibly more AI-enabled than when you joined - new tools adopted, old manual tasks automated, engineers unblocked faster Requirements Who You Are Deeply AI-integrated, not just AI-aware. You've gone well past "I use ChatGPT to write emails." Your engineers expect you to bring new AI workflows to the team - you've used Claude to accelerate code review, built prompts that help engineers write sharper tickets, or led your team's adoption of Copilot in the development workflow. When you see a task eating team time, your first instinct is to figure out if AI can handle it. You're actively experimenting, sharing what works, and setting the pace on AI adoption for your team - not following someone else's lead. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your AI usage stops at occasional prompting, if you're still evaluating whether the tools are worth the learning curve, or if you'd describe yourself as "AI-curious" rather than AI-native. A people developer, not just a delivery manager. You can give concrete examples of career growth plans you've built, hard conversations you've had, and underperformers you've managed through a structured process. You spend your 1:1 time on people, not status updates. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your management examples are mostly about process improvements or shipping milestones - or if you tend to blame team outcomes on the engineers rather than the environment you built. Remote-native. You've led full-remote teams before - not just as a workaround during COVID, but as a default. You know how to build trust without shared physical space, how to run async decision-making, and how to keep distributed engineers from feeling isolated. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you haven't managed a fully remote team in a leadership position, or if you feel like remote work is harder than in-person management. Direct in conflict. When there's tension on the team - between engineers, between engineering and product, between a team member's performance and what's expected - you address it directly and quickly. You don't let it simmer. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you've left roles or situations because of unresolved conflict, or if your conflict resolution examples are mostly about "creating space for dialogue" without resolution. Data-driven about people and delivery. You can articulate your team's performance in metrics - not just vibes. You track velocity, retention risk, and IC growth, and you use that data to make decisions. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your answers to performance questions are mostly common-sense observations without examples tied to specific numbers or outcomes. Technically credible. You stay close enough to the code to earn your engineers' respect - code reviews, architectural input, helping debug under pressure. You don't need to be the best engineer in the room, but your team needs to believe you understand what they're doing. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you've fully transitioned to pure management and haven't touched technical work in years. A delegator, not a bottleneck. Your job is to build a team that makes good decisions without you - not to be the person all decisions flow through. You coach engineers toward answers rather than providing them. When you go hands-on, it's deliberate and time-bounded, not a default. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your instinct when a team struggles is to take over, if you find yourself becoming the access point for all requests, or if your team's output goes down when you're unavailable. This Role Is NOT A pure technical architect role. The team has senior engineers. Your job is to make sure they're effective and growing, not to be the smartest person in every technical conversation A process manager. We have processes. Your job isn't to document them better - it's to lead the people running them and improve outcomes A stepping stone. We're looking for someone committed to people leadership as their primary craft - not someone who's considering moving back to IC or is ambivalent about managing people vs. building systems A reactive firefighter. We want someone who surfaces risk early and manages it proactively - not someone who thrives in chaos and sees every crisis as a badge of honor An AI skeptic in a leadership seat. We expect our engineering leaders to actively drive AI adoption on their teams, not wait to be convinced Benefits Rate: $120,000-$140,000 USD annually (contractor), depending on experience Location: Fully remote - this role is built for remote-first leaders Flexibility: Structured work hours with reasonable flexibility for life LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.

Highly experienced with MPI, CUDA, OpenMP or other parallel programming models on GPU and CPU HPC architectures. Distributed training and inference of deep learning models (DDP/FSDP, mixed precision) and MLOps practices (experiment tracking, model registry, deployment). UNIX/Linux and POSIX programming, Git, automated testing and CI/CD. About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and related services, with over $150M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services. About Engineering Quality At LawnStarter Our QA team is growing, and we're investing real money in better test coverage. We already have shared quality standards and a QA squad that organizes itself horizontally across teams. What we don't have is someone dedicated to owning that vision: every QA is heads-down on their own team, so nobody has the room to drive the standards forward, unify how the squad works, or push the state of the art. That's the gap this role fills. It's not a nice-to-have we're adding because things are going well. It's the structure and leadership we need to make what we've already built actually compound. The Role You'll be LawnStarter's first Principal Quality Engineer, reporting directly to the Head of Engineering. We already have quality standards, working CI/CD gates, and AI tooling in the mix. Nobody owns the vision behind all of it, drives it forward, or leads the QA squad that keeps it running. You will. This isn't a QA management job today. You won't spend your day approving tickets or chasing bug counts. You'll take ownership of the standards and tooling that already exist, work collaboratively with the QA squad to improve them, and keep pushing the state of quality engineering forward as the org grows. As the QA squad grows, this role could take on direct people management of QAs, so hiring, coaching, and performance management experience is a real plus even though it's not the day-one job. You're not starting from zero, and you're not inheriting a mess either. That means the job isn't "invent a strategy nobody has thought about." It's "listen to the QAs who live in this every day, understand where the pain is, and lead them toward what's next." We need someone who reads where LawnStarter is today and builds from there, not someone who shows up with a favorite tool stack and a coverage number they picked before they met the team. What Makes This Role Different You own and evolve the quality strategy together with the QA team, instead of building one in a vacuum or just executing someone else's You have direct sponsorship from the Head of Engineering and the room to keep growing the AI-native tooling already in the mix Your success is measured by how much better the whole engineering org's quality gets under your leadership, not by a headcount number What You'll Own Strategy and vision: The company-wide quality engineering roadmap, plus a quality accountability framework that spells out what engineers, EMs, and PMs each own at every stage of building software Test strategy across the stack: Unit, component, contract, API, end-to-end, mobile, and non-functional testing (performance, load, accessibility), agreed with each team as their quality contract AI-native quality tooling: AI agents and skills, including Claude Code style tooling, that any engineer can run on demand for test generation, code review, and quality guidance. You'll keep hunting for the next AI capability worth putting in front of the team CI/CD and test infrastructure: Required checks, quality gates, E2E and visual regression pipelines, performance budgets, and the mobile test automation strategy across emulators and real device clouds. That includes deciding what actually needs to block a deploy versus what can run async, and keeping the pipeline itself fast Production quality signal: Tying monitoring into incident response and building dashboards teams actually check, not ones that just exist Technical mentorship of the QA discipline: QA engineers keep reporting to their own Engineering Managers today. You won't manage their day-to-day or their careers right now. You'll own the technical and craft side of QA org-wide, mentor QA engineers across every squad, and send your input to their EMs to feed performance reviews. That could change as the squad grows into a direct reporting line to this role Problems to Solve A solid quality bar with no one steering it. We already have shared standards, working quality gates, and AI tooling in the mix. What's missing is someone whose job is to look at all of it, decide what needs to improve next, and actually drive that improvement instead of it being everyone's part-time responsibility. A QA squad with no dedicated leadership. Our QAs already organize horizontally across teams, but every one of them is focused on their own team's work day to day. Nobody has the bandwidth to unify how they work, spread what's working on one team to the others, or represent their pain points where decisions get made. You'll give that squad the structure and leadership it's missing. Standards that need continuous R&D, not a rewrite. The foundation works. The risk is standing still while the org grows. You'll keep pushing the state of the art, testing new approaches and tools, and deciding what's worth rolling out broadly versus what stays an experiment. Quality work that's still someone's side project. Right now, improving quality practice competes with each QA's day-to-day team commitments. You'll make it someone's actual job to carry that forward, and get engineers, EMs, and PMs treating it as planned work instead of something squeezed in. What Success Looks Like (Year 1) A clear quality vision, owned and communicated: Every product team can point to what "good" means for their testing and why, with you as the person who set that direction and keeps it current Measurable improvement on existing gates: Flakiness, pipeline cost, and what runs sync versus async on core repositories are visibly better than when you started, not just maintained At least one new AI-native capability shipped: You've pushed the existing AI tooling forward with something new, like an added test-generation flow or audit, that engineers actually reach for weekly A QA squad that feels led: The QAs across teams can point to concrete ways their work, tools, or standards improved because someone was finally driving it Requirements Who You Are AI-native, specifically for quality work. You already use AI to generate tests, not just to autocomplete code. You've set up agentic tooling like Claude Code or MCP-based workflows so engineers can run on-demand test generation or code review against their own repos, and you keep experimenting with what AI can take off a team's plate next. This is unlikely to be a good fit if AI tools mostly make you nervous, or your use of them stops at your own personal productivity. A strategic thinker, not a tool zealot. Give you a team's current maturity level, and you'll design the testing approach that fits where they are, not the one you used at your last job. You resist the urge to mandate a specific framework or a specific coverage number before you understand the context. Someone who shows up insisting "we need to hit 90% coverage" or "everyone must use Playwright" without first learning how the team works will struggle here. Deeply hands-on across the whole test pyramid. You've built and maintained component, contract, API, E2E, and performance test suites yourself, not just reviewed slides about them. You're the person who steps in when the engineering team is blocked by the pipeline and can't ship. If your test automation experience stops at reading dashboards other people built, this role will feel out of reach fast. A patient teacher who still ships. Coaching engineers on testing practice and running enablement sessions is part of the job. So is personally building the CI pipelines and the tooling. You don't write the doc and hope someone else implements it. This is unlikely to be a good fit for someone who only wants to advise, or who avoids hands-on infrastructure work. Comfortable owning influence without owning headcount, at least for now. You'll mentor QA engineers across every squad on technical craft and send notes to their EMs for performance reviews. You won't be their manager on day one, and you won't set their career path. This works well if you're motivated by discipline-wide technical influence. It won't if you need direct reports from the start to feel engaged. If you've hired, coached, and managed performance for a QA or engineering team before, that's a genuine plus: this role could grow into managing the QA squad directly as it scales. This Role Is NOT A traditional QA management job, at least not on day one: You won't manage QA engineers day to day or own their career growth right now. Their EMs do that. You own the technical and strategic direction of the QA discipline instead, with the door open to direct management as the squad grows A "throw out what's there and start over" job: We have real standards and tooling worth building on. You can't parachute in with a pre-packaged process or a favorite tool stack and mandate it regardless of fit A ticket-approval or gatekeeping role: You're not the last line of defense that blocks releases at the end. You're embedding quality earlier, so there's less to block A headcount-growth play: Your success isn't measured by how big a QA team you build. It's measured by how much better the whole engineering org's quality gets Benefits Compensation & Benefits Base salary: $80,000-$100,000 USD annually Fully remote: This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours Flexible PTO: Measured on outcomes, not hours logged LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.

descricao: About Nu Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role As a Lead Security Engineer you will be a senior technical and risk reference who moves where the risk is, across TPRM, Security Awareness and Cyber Risk, rather than owning a single silo. You will assess security gaps across diverse technologies, third parties and business contexts, quantify what matters, and turn it into prioritized, actionable treatment plans that leadership can decide on. You will build and evolve the policies, methodologies, platforms and automation behind these programs, and help the squad scale across Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and other geos without scaling headcount linearly. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, Procurement, Operations, Internal Communication, Risk teams and the business stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, pragmatic technical specifications. This is a multidisciplinary and global role, working with teams primarily based in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and the United States. You will be responsible for Assess security gaps across business processes and technologies, enable effective risk treatment, and define remediation plans with clear owners and deadlines. Work closely with ITSec, Risk, Procurement stakeholders to align on mitigation of identified risks and on risk acceptance decisions. Lead the evolution of the TPRM program toward a risk-based, lifecycle model: onboarding, continuous monitoring, offboarding, and fourth-party visibility. Define/review security requirements for third parties, including contractual security clauses and annexes, and guide business owners on their application. Build and scale automation and AI-assisted assessment capabilities that reduce manual questionnaire effort and increase coverage. Report third-party risk posture and trends to leadership and relevant committees. Drive human risk programs through phishing simulations, training and communication and evaluate and evolve the tooling behind them (build versus buy). Define and track behavior-change metrics that go beyond completion rates, and report them through dashboards for management. Act as technical lead across the squad, raising the technical and analytical bar and fostering continuous improvement. We Are Looking For a Person Who Has Proven experience designing and implementing security controls and leading risk management initiatives, with strong knowledge of domains and concepts of cyber risks. Hands-on experience with risk analysis techniques: risk identification, assessment and prioritization, using both qualitative and quantitative methods. Experience with TPRM (third-party risk management). Experience building or running security awareness and human-risk programs, or a strong ability to ramp up on them quickly. Experience with large-scale distributed environments and cloud environments (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure). Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-30, ISO 27001/27002/27005, ISO 31000, PCI-DSS, ITIL, COBIT and similar. Excellent executive communication skills, able to translate complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees. Technical background and comfort with automation, scripting and AI or LLM-based tooling to scale security processes. Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators. Proven ability to lead projects and process improvement initiatives, and to mentor other engineers and analysts. Advanced English proficiency, written and spoken. Spanish is a plus. Nice to have Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Information Security, Risk Management or related fields. Certifications such as PCI ISA or PCIP, CISA, CISM or CISSP. Experience in a regulated fintech, financial services environment or consulting roles. Experience with AI risk: assessing risks of generative AI and LLM use cases (data leakage, prompt injection, model and vendor risk) Location for this opportunity (City, Country) São Paulo, Brazil Campinas, Brazil Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Belo Horizonte, Brazil Benefits Chance of earning equity at Nubank Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação) Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte) NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program Life Insurance Medical Plan Dental Plan NuLanguage – Language Course Program Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses Extended Parental Leave Daycare Allowance Parental Consultancy Work-from-home Allowance Gym Partnerships 30 days of paid vacation Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable Work Model for this Role Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. descricao: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role Overview Magnet Forensics, a leader in digital forensics solutions, is seeking a dynamic Director of Sales to lead a team of Account Managers covering the LATAM region. This pivotal role is responsible for driving the team to exceed revenue targets and execute the company’s go-to-market strategy. The Director will actively engage in the region to identify, progress, and close strategic opportunities while fostering a high-performance team culture. Collaborating cross-functionally across the Company, the Director will ensure alignment to achieve revenue goals. The ideal candidate is a proven sales leader with exceptional coaching, presentation and selling skills. What You’ll Do Team Leadership and Development: Lead, coach, and motivate a team of four Account Managers to exceed revenue targets and maintain consistent quarterly linearity. Focus on team performance, learning and development opportunities to enhance sales capabilities. Manage and grow channel program in region, ensuring quota, linearity, and market penetration across region Revenue And Go-to-Market Execution Drive the team to execute Magnet Forensics’ go-to-market strategy, focusing on selling the full portfolio of enterprise-grade digital forensics products. Grow multi-product customer accounts, increase average deal size, acquire new logos, and displace competitive solutions. Actively participate in the territory to identify, progress, and close strategic opportunities, with a focus on selling higher within accounts. Deliver accurate weekly sales forecasts and ad-hoc updates to ensure predictability and alignment with revenue goals. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with other internal stakeholder teams (Renewals, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Rev Ops etc) to drive cohesive strategies that support revenue attainment. Leverage insights from cross-functional teams to refine sales approaches and enhance customer engagement. Operational Excellence Utilize available resources and tools to manage sales processes, track performance, and optimize team productivity. Travel will be required approximately 50%+ of the time to engage with customers, support the team, and attend strategic meetings or events. Ensure the team adheres to best practices in pipeline management, opportunity progression, and customer relationship development. What We’re Looking For 7+ years of sales leadership experience, preferably in law enforcement software sales or technology solutions, with a track record of consistently exceeding revenue targets. Proven experience managing, coaching and developing a team of Account Managers Strong background in selling to public safety, law enforcement, or government sectors in the LATAM market; familiarity with digital forensics or cybersecurity solutions is a plus. Demonstrated success in executing go-to-market strategies, growing multi-product accounts, increasing deal sizes, and displacing competitors. Exceptional presentation, coaching, and consultative selling skills, with the ability to engage senior-level stakeholders. Proficiency in Salesforce, Microsoft 365, Clari, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and SalesLoft for sales forecasting, pipeline growth, and process optimization. Strong analytical skills to produce accurate forecasts and interpret sales performance metrics. Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach to driving deals and supporting the team in the field. High-energy leader with a passion for building a culture of accountability and success. Proficiency in speaking English, Portuguese, and Spanish *Willingness to travel approximately 50 - 75% of the time across the LATAM region. Magnet Is Proud To Offer Benefits Such As Generous time off policies Competitive compensation Volunteer opportunities Reward and recognition programs Employee committees & resource groups Healthcare and retirement benefits Indicators of Success We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways. titulo: Senior Specialist, Creative Strategy & Performance (Paid Marketing)
local: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
descricao: Company Description At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients. Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es Why join us? 📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference. 📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on. ✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success. Job Description Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline. You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap. We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on! How will you make an impact? Creative Strategy Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements Asset Preparation & Coordination Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework Creative Intelligence & Testing Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs Tracking & Measurement Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines Team Flexibility Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives. What We're Looking For 4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus) Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously Nice to Have Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models What To Expect From Our Hiring Process We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role): 1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation. 2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment). 3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role . Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too. 4️⃣ Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings. 5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team. 6️⃣ References & Offer! Why You’ll Love It Here 💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to: Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters. Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered. Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance. 📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave. 🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects. 🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment. ⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna. Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role. Descrição da vaga Sobre a área e o desafio: A Diretoria de Plataformas de Monetização é responsável por evoluir as capacidades digitais que sustentam a geração de receita da Globo, conectando tecnologia, produto e negócio. Atua tanto no ecossistema de Advertising B2B, apoiando a relação com anunciantes e parceiros, quanto na jornada de vendas de assinaturas das nossas plataformas digitais, com impacto direto na experiência do consumidor, conversão, retenção e recorrência. A área tem papel relevante nas decisões de tecnologia que suportam o negócio digital da Globo e a evolução dos produtos digitais da Globo, atuando em parceria com diferentes áreas na definição de prioridades, arquitetura e evolução das plataformas. O desafio dessa posição é liderar um ecossistema tecnológico crítico para a monetização da Globo, combinando transformação e excelência operacional em plataformas que precisam responder à escala do negócio, à alta disponibilidade e a momentos de grande demanda, como eventos ao vivo. Responsabilidades e atribuições Como será seu dia a dia: Liderar a estratégia e a evolução das plataformas digitais de monetização, conectando prioridades de negócio, produto e tecnologia e participando das decisões que impactam a evolução do Globoplay. Evoluir o ecossistema de Advertising B2B, fortalecendo as capacidades que suportam anunciantes, parceiros comerciais e diferentes modelos de publicidade, incluindo a integração entre publicidade linear e digital e a evolução das jornadas de venda self-service. Liderar a evolução da jornada D2C de assinaturas das plataformas digitais, contemplando aquisição, conversão, meios de pagamento, recorrência, retenção e relacionamento com o consumidor. Garantir uma visão integrada das plataformas e jornadas de monetização, equilibrando experiência de anunciantes e consumidores, resultados de negócio, escala, segurança e evolução tecnológica. Responder pelas plataformas dos canais digitais de vendas e pelo core comercial, incluindo CRM, cobrança, meios de pagamento, prevenção a fraudes, orquestração e integrações entre sistemas. Acompanhar e direcionar a evolução das plataformas a partir de indicadores críticos de negócio e experiência, como conversão, churn, antifraude, chargeback, NPS e contenção, entre outros indicadores relevantes para as jornadas sob sua responsabilidade. Garantir estabilidade, resiliência e alta disponibilidade das plataformas, considerando a escala da operação da Globo e a criticidade de jornadas associadas a eventos ao vivo e momentos de grande audiência e demanda. Conduzir a evolução integrada de soluções de mercado e sistemas proprietários, com olhar para arquitetura, segurança, escalabilidade, eficiência e sustentabilidade tecnológica. Impulsionar o uso de dados, IA generativa e agentes ao longo das jornadas de anunciantes e consumidores, buscando novas experiências, automação e eficiência operacional. Atuar de forma próxima às áreas de Negócio, Produto e Tecnologia, transformando desafios e oportunidades em uma agenda clara de evolução das plataformas. Liderar equipes e a gestão de fornecedores, contratos, orçamento e prioridades de transformação, incluindo construção de business cases, análise de TCO e negociação com grandes parceiros de tecnologia. Requisitos e qualificações Do que você precisa: Experiência sólida em posições de liderança de tecnologia em organizações de grande porte e ambientes de alta complexidade, com atuação próxima ao negócio e capacidade de conectar decisões tecnológicas à estratégia. Experiência na liderança de plataformas enterprise de CRM, vendas e relacionamento em escala, incluindo a gestão de ecossistemas que combinem soluções de mercado e sistemas proprietários. Conhecimento consistente de engenharia de software, arquitetura e integração de plataformas, com capacidade de liderar ambientes críticos, escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade. Vivência com plataformas de vendas, CRM, cobrança, meios de pagamento, dados, antifraude e integrações corporativas. Capacidade de liderar ecossistemas tecnológicos complexos e times multidisciplinares, conciliando excelência operacional, evolução tecnológica e transformação. Experiência em gestão econômica de tecnologia, incluindo construção de business cases, análise de TCO, gestão orçamentária e negociação com fornecedores estratégicos. Conhecimento de práticas de segurança, privacidade e compliance aplicáveis às plataformas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo LGPD e PCI. Capacidade de aplicar dados, IA generativa e agentes à evolução de produtos, jornadas, plataformas e eficiência operacional, sempre conectados a resultados de negócio. Experiência trabalhando em modelos ágeis e conduzindo diferentes stakeholders em torno de prioridades comuns. Inglês fluente, considerando a interação com fornecedores e parceiros globais. Formação superior em Tecnologia, Engenharia, Computação, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Conhecimento de Oracle e integrações com ERP. Vivência em ambientes que combinem grandes plataformas de mercado e soluções proprietárias. Repertório nos ecossistemas de mídia, publicidade, Adtech ou Martech. Conhecimento de jornadas e tecnologias relacionadas a inventário, catálogo, criativos, venda e entrega de publicidade, incluindo modelos lineares, digitais e self-service. The Big Data Fabric Services (BDFS) enables SAP Lines of Business and customers to easily enter the world of Big Data and enable customers to integrate SAP data with external partner data engineering tools and non-SAP data. We are looking for a Developer / Platform Engineer with strong backend development skills and working knowledge of cloud-native application development. The role is suitable for an experienced engineer who can contribute independently to development, troubleshooting, quality, and delivery of platform services. This is not a data scientist role. The team builds and operates platform services that enable scalable, secure, and reliable data storage and access. THE PRODUCT The major goal of BDFS is to enable SAP Lines of Business (LoB’s) and customers to enter the world of big data easily. To achieve that objective, we’re delivering Apache Spark as a service, a multi-language engine for executing data engineering, data science, and machine learning on single-node machines or clusters (Kubernetes in our case). We’re enabling data to be consumed from multiple hyperscaler agnostic data sources using the Delta Sharing communication protocol on top of the HANA Data Lake File Service (HDLFS), an SAP-managed cloud object storage that allows storage and consumption of data without multiple layers of ETL (Extract Transform and Load) systems and intermediary data storages (Lakehouse architecture). What You’ll Do As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for architecture, design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, and quality assurance activities in a development team. In Your Day-to-day Work, Your Tasks Will Include Drive architecture and technical design discussions. Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable cloud-native backend services. Own complex technical topics from analysis and design to implementation and delivery. Contribute to platform architecture decisions around service lifecycle, provisioning, credentials, configuration, resiliency, observability, and operational readiness. Develop backend services and platform components using Java and related technologies. Work on distributed applications and services running in cloud/container environments. Evaluate technical options, identify trade-offs, and recommend practical architecture solutions. Contribute to secure-by-design architecture and platform engineering practices. Ensure platform services follow security, reliability, scalability, and operational best practices. Contribute to architecture discussions around authentication, authorization, secrets management, encryption, and secure multi-tenant design. Support observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational readiness practices for platform services. Build PoCs and validate technical approaches for complex platform topics. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production and development issues. Review code, design documents, and implementation approaches to ensure high engineering quality. Mentor and guide junior developers and help improve technical maturity within the team. Support Product team and Architects in technical discussions and planning. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across locations. Work in an agile team that uses the Scrum framework to self-organize and work towards development goals. Contribute to engineering practices around clean code, CI/CD, testing, automation, security, observability, and operational excellence. What You Bring Required Skills Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or related technical fields. Advanced or fluent English. Strong hands-on experience in backend/platform engineering. Excellent programming skills, preferably with Java and/or Go. Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, space complexity, and run-time complexity. Strong understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, clean code, and software architecture principles. Experience designing and building cloud-native distributed systems. Experience with Kubernetes, containerized applications, and cloud deployment models. Experience with at least one hyperscaler or cloud ecosystem such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Strong understanding of REST APIs, service integrations, distributed application design, and failure handling. Ability to define and evaluate architecture trade-offs around scalability, availability, reliability, maintainability, security, and cost. Ability to troubleshoot complex software and platform issues using technical and product knowledge. Experience with CI/CD, code review, test-driven development, and modern software delivery practices. Knowledge of software quality assurance and test methodologies, including unit testing, integration testing, and automation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to mentor developers and support technical decision-making. Ability to quickly learn new areas of knowledge and drive topics independently. High level of ownership, commitment, team spirit, flexibility, and initiative. NICE TO HAVE Experience with cloud object storage services such as AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, or Google Cloud Storage. Exposure to Object Store, service broker patterns, provisioning flows, credential handling, or service lifecycle management. Experience with infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform, Helm, or similar. Experience with Linux, scripting, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering. Experience with observability topics such as logging, metrics, tracing, monitoring, alerting, and incident analysis. Experience with secure multi-tenant cloud services. Experience with performance optimization, reliability engineering, or cost optimization. Exposure to Apache Spark, Delta Sharing, Lakehouse architecture, or big data platform services. Experience working with globally distributed agile/Scrum development teams. Experience in technical mentoring, architecture reviews, design reviews, or technical leadership. LEARNING OPPORTUNITIES You will work on architecture and engineering topics for enterprise-grade cloud platform services. You will work on cloud-native backend services, distributed systems, and secure multi-tenant platform capabilities. You will influence architecture decisions around scalability, reliability, observability, automation, and operational readiness. You will collaborate with experienced developers, architects, product owners, and platform teams across locations. You will help shape engineering practices and mentor developers in backend and platform engineering topics. MEET YOUR TEAM Responsibilities You will work with your team on the SAP HANA Cloud Big Data Fabric Services. This product helps our customers access data from anywhere. The Big Data Fabric Services team is responsible for: Extend and complete the SAP Data Platform with big data technologies and third-party partnerships to support different SAP Lines of Business and SAP customers to enter the world of Big Data. Leverage Apache Spark and Object store technology to provide scalable and cost-effective computing and storage services for big data ingestion, processing, and sharing. Integrate into SAP BTP and HANA Cloud to offer unified development and deployment experience for different SAP Lines of Business. Assure multi-tenancy and secure data processing. In the BDFS team, we have an agile and collaborative culture where knowledge sharing is fostered. Bring out your best SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. The Role We’re hiring an Implementation Engineer for ERP integrations to help customers connect their ERP systems — including Eclipse, P21, and Infor — with Canals. What You’ll Do Implement integrations between Canals and integration partners, including ERPs (Eclipse, P21, Infor, SAP, Acumatica), using standardized templates and API credentials Become an ERP subject-matter expert, understanding how each system handles data, access, authentication, and configuration. Surveiller proactivement la santé des comptes : identifier les risques techniques, communiquer sur les incidents et les RCA, suivre la disponibilité et détecter les problèmes potentiels avant qu’ils ne deviennent bloquants. Travailler de façon transverse avec l’Account Management, le Produit, le SRE et l’Ingénierie pour traduire les besoins des clients en solutions techniques efficaces. Améliorer l’expérience des clients grands comptes en identifiant les problèmes techniques récurrents et en créant de meilleurs processus d’onboarding et d’exploitation. Profil recherché 5 ans et plus d’expérience en tant que Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager ou dans un rôle technique similaire en contact avec les clients. Expérience avec l’infrastructure cloud, l’infrastructure GPU, l’infrastructure IA ou le calcul en entreprise. Solide compréhension de l’infrastructure de production et capacité à distinguer les problèmes côté client de ceux relevant du SRE ou de l’ingénierie. Excellentes compétences de communication et capacité à expliquer clairement des concepts techniques complexes à des interlocuteurs techniques comme non techniques. Très proactif et autonome : vous savez identifier ce qu’il faut faire ensuite sans attendre d’instructions. Fort sens de l’appropriation : vous suivez les problèmes jusqu’à leur résolution au lieu de simplement les transmettre à une autre équipe. À l’aise dans un environnement dynamique où les processus sont encore en construction. L’anglais courant est INDISPENSABLE et le français est souhaité. Descrição da vaga Quem somos? A Companhia Riograndense de Saneamento foi fundada em 28 de março de 1966 tendo como objeto a realização de estudos, projetos, construções, operações, exploração e ampliação dos serviços públicos de abastecimento de água potável e de esgotamento sanitário no Rio Grande do Sul. Atualmente, a Corsan atua em 317 municípios, atendendo cerca de 6,5 milhões de gaúchos, pouco mais da metade da população do Estado. Em leilão no dia 20 de dezembro de 2020 a estatal foi adquirida pela Aegea Saneamento, que assumiu a administração da Companhia em 7 de julho de 2023. Por que trabalhar conosco? Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 154 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de 21 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar. Responsabilidades e atribuições Principais Atividades Desenvolver, analisar e aprimorar relatórios e dashboards utilizando Power BI, Excel, HTML e outras ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados. Consolidar, tratar e reportar dados relacionados à execução dos serviços, garantindo a confiabilidade, a consistência e a qualidade das informações. Analisar indicadores de desempenho, identificar desvios, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria, propondo planos de ação fundamentados em dados. Divulgar periodicamente resultados e indicadores às áreas interessadas, promovendo o alinhamento, a transparência e a tomada de decisão orientada por dados. Interagir com as áreas envolvidas para acompanhar planos de ação, apoiar a resolução de problemas e contribuir para o alcance dos resultados esperados. Promover a melhoria contínua e a padronização de processos, métodos de análise e rotinas de acompanhamento de desempenho. Manter e aperfeiçoar as rotinas de análise, consolidação e divulgação de dados e indicadores, buscando maior eficiência, agilidade e precisão. Monitorar o cumprimento dos indicadores de performance, apoiar as áreas responsáveis no atingimento das metas e contribuir para a melhoria dos resultados operacionais. Requisitos e qualificações Requisitos Conhecimento em Pacote Office; Experiência com Power BI; Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA; Conhecimento em SQL. Diferenciais Experiência com automação de processos; Conhecimento em Field Service e/ou SAP; Conhecimento em Python. Informações adicionais Assistência médica; Assistência odontológica; Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional); Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro); Seguro de vida; Vale transporte; Gympass; Vale alimentação e/ou refeição; Café da manhã na empresa; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados; Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta! A Corsan, agora parte do Grupo Aegea Saneamento, representa um novo capítulo na história de serviços de saneamento no Brasil. A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no país, trabalhando por um futuro sustentável e fazendo a diferença +892 municípios. Com mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas beneficiadas, a Aegea leva saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade de norte a sul do Brasil. Nossos esforços vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário, com uma paixão em melhorar o ambiente tanto para nossos colaboradores quanto para as comunidades que servimos. Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias têm de único. Com mais de 25.000 colaboradores em diversos cantos do Brasil, oferecemos soluções de saneamento eficientes e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades de cada localidade. Somos uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, sempre buscando aprender e evoluir. O Financeiro da TAG tem duas frentes, Controladoria e FP&A. Essa pessoa faz parte da Controladoria e vai ser dona do caixa e das posições a pagar e a receber da TAG. A missão é saber, a qualquer momento, quanto entra, quanto sai e o que está em aberto, e entregar isso conciliado para a controladoria e a contabilidade. Na TAG, isso significa acompanhar uma receita que entra quase toda parcelada no cartão, por mais de uma adquirente. Também significa revisar as despesas que as próprias áreas lançam no ERP e organizar a documentação de mais de 40 mil notas fiscais por mês. Buscamos alguém organizado e cuidadoso com número, que trabalha com rotina em vez de montar tudo na hora e que pergunta quando algo não bate. Também queremos alguém com vontade de crescer, tanto em conciliações mais complexas quanto no uso de tecnologia para tirar trabalho manual do dia a dia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Como vai ser o seu dia a dia Fluxo de caixa: mantendo diariamente o fluxo de caixa realizado, conciliado com os extratos bancários, e o projetado para os próximos um a três meses, que é a base do planejamento de caixa do FP&A Gestão de liquidez: executando aplicações e resgates conforme as decisões da liderança financeira. Sinalizando com antecedência qualquer aperto de caixa, trazendo as opções e o custo de cada uma Contas a pagar: revisando os lançamentos das áreas no Omie (nota fiscal, retenções, classificação, centro de custo e competência) e devolvendo para correção o que estiver fora do padrão. Incluindo os pagamentos no banco, com aprovação e liberação feitas por outra pessoa Posição a pagar: mantendo o contas a pagar e o aging atualizados, incluindo as despesas do mês que ainda não têm nota, para provisão Recebíveis de cartão: conciliando o que as adquirentes pagam por componente (venda, taxa, antecipação, cancelamento e chargeback), ligando cada valor às notas fiscais. Conferindo as taxas cobradas contra o contrato e acompanhando o custo das antecipações Contas a receber: acompanhando e cobrando os recebíveis fora do cartão, como os de parcerias Entregas à contabilidade: enviando no prazo os XML de NF-e, NFS-e e CT-e, com checagem de completude, e o pacote mensal de fechamento (extratos, relatórios e notas com retenção) Melhoria de processos: propondo e implementando automações que reduzam trabalho manual, usando Excel, Omie e ferramentas de IA Requisitos e qualificações O que esperamos de você Graduação nas áreas de Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou Engenharia Experiência com tesouraria, contas a pagar e contas a receber Entendimento do caminho do pagamento até a contabilidade: competência, retenções na fonte, débito e crédito Excel avançado Vivência com ERP (Omie ou similares) e internet banking Rigor com número: quando algo não bate, explicar a diferença em vez de ajustar para fechar Será um diferencial se você tiver Experiência com conciliação de recebíveis de cartão e portais de adquirentes Experiência em empresa de receita recorrente ou assinatura Experiência com automação de rotinas financeiras ou uso de IA no trabalho Identificação com a leitura e o universo literário Informações adicionais O que você vai encontrar ao fazer parte do time TAG: 🍽️ Vale Alimentação no cartão Flash (Visa) — liberdade para escolher onde utilizar. 🩺 Plano de Saúde e Odontológico — duas opções para você escolher a que melhor se adapta às suas necessidades. 📚 Leitura sempre por perto! — Assinatura gratuita da TAG Curadoria ou TAG Inéditos e desconto no segundo kit e na Livraria da TAG. 🎂 Dia de Folga no Aniversário — para comemorar do jeito que preferir! 💪 Acesso com desconto em academias e estúdios de todo o Brasil — para cuidar da saúde com o Totalpass. 🚗 Auxílio Mobilidade — porque chegar até aqui também faz parte da experiência. 🤱 Política Alegrias da Parentalidade — apoio estendido para pais e mães, com licenças ampliadas e outros benefícios especiais. 🎓 Incentivo ao Desenvolvimento — suporte para cursos, livros, eventos e tudo o que contribua para o seu crescimento. 🌟 Ambiente descontraído e horários flexíveis — porque acreditamos em um trabalho leve e com autonomia. 🌐 Modelo Híbrido de Trabalho — dois dias por semana no escritório, em Porto Alegre (Instituto Caldeira).

O time de FP&A (Planejamento e Análise Financeira) é responsável por apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisões estratégicas, conectando planejamento financeiro, desempenho operacional e rentabilidade do negócio. Essa posição terá atuação consultiva junto às unidades de SaaS e Serviços da Petlove, contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável, a eficiência na alocação de recursos e a construção de análises que apoiem decisões estratégicas das lideranças. Principais Atividades Elaborar e acompanhar o planejamento financeiro, incluindo orçamento, revisões orçamentárias e projeções de resultados, garantindo uma alocação eficiente de recursos. Analisar mensalmente os resultados realizados versus orçado, identificando desvios, investigando suas causas e propondo ações corretivas. Desenvolver modelos financeiros para diferentes cenários de negócio, avaliando crescimento, escalabilidade, rentabilidade e necessidades de investimento. Realizar análises de viabilidade econômico-financeira de novas iniciativas, projetos e investimentos, apoiando a tomada de decisão das lideranças. Atuar como Business Partner das unidades de SaaS e Serviços, conectando indicadores operacionais aos resultados financeiros e identificando oportunidades de melhoria de performance. Preparar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas sobre desempenho financeiro, tendências, riscos e oportunidades para a liderança e o conselho de investidores. Analisar alocação de capital, custos, receitas e margens, identificando oportunidades de otimização de recursos e aumento da rentabilidade. Atuar em parceria com os times de contabilidade e consolidação durante os fechamentos mensais, garantindo consistência entre os resultados contábeis, gerenciais e orçamentários. Consolidar e analisar informações provenientes de diferentes sistemas e bases de dados, assegurando a qualidade e a confiabilidade das análises e dos indicadores. Atender demandas estratégicas e estudos ad hoc da diretoria, incluindo análises de sensibilidade, projeções financeiras e avaliação de cenários. Utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial e automação para aumentar a produtividade das análises, mantendo senso crítico na validação de premissas, dados e resultados. Construir relacionamentos com diferentes áreas da companhia, traduzindo informações financeiras em recomendações claras e acionáveis para o negócio. Stacks & Tecnologias O Que Usamos No Nosso Dia a Dia Excel e Google Planilhas para modelagem financeira, análises e projeções. PowerPoint e Google Apresentações para relatórios e apresentações executivas. Power BI para visualização de dados e acompanhamento de indicadores. BigQuery e SQL para consulta, extração e análise de bases de dados. Ferramentas de inteligência artificial aplicadas à análise financeira, automação e construção de cenários. Requisitos Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em Planejamento Financeiro e Análise (FP&A), com atuação em orçamento, forecast, análise de resultados e acompanhamento de indicadores financeiros. Experiência em modelagem financeira avançada, com capacidade de construir modelos de DRE, fluxo de caixa, balanço patrimonial e projeções a partir de diferentes premissas e cenários. Vivência em análises de rentabilidade, escalabilidade, alocação de capital e viabilidade econômico-financeira de projetos e investimentos. Experiência na atuação como Business Partner, apoiando áreas de negócio e lideranças na tomada de decisões. Capacidade de cruzar informações de diferentes fontes, analisar bases complexas e transformar dados em recomendações estratégicas. Conhecimento avançado de Excel e/ou Google Planilhas, além de habilidade para elaborar apresentações executivas. Capacidade de investigar desvios entre realizado e orçado, identificar causas-raiz e antecipar riscos e oportunidades. Comunicação clara e assertiva, com habilidade para transitar entre diferentes áreas e traduzir conceitos financeiros para públicos não financeiros. Perfil analítico, crítico, proativo e autônomo, com senso de responsabilidade sobre prazos, qualidade das entregas e resultados do negócio. Diferenciais Experiência em empresas de SaaS, serviços ou negócios com diferentes unidades operacionais. Conhecimento de Power BI, BigQuery e SQL para extração, tratamento e análise de dados. Experiência com processos de consolidação financeira e interface com contabilidade. Vivência na construção de modelos financeiros para negócios em crescimento, com foco em rentabilidade e eficiência operacional. Somos o maior ecossistema pet do Brasil, unidos por um propósito: transformar o mundo em um lugar onde os pets sejam mais felizes e saudáveis. Pioneiros no digital, oferecemos tudo o que o seu pet precisa, em um só lugar: e-commerce, app, lojas físicas, planos de saúde pet, creche, hospedagem e muito mais! Oferecemos programas de desenvolvimento, oportunidades de crescimento e ações voltadas para a qualidade de vida, vinculados aos nossos valores e cultura. Além disso, disponibilizamos um amplo pacote de benefícios que inclui: Assistência médica; Plano odontológico; Vale Alimentação; Auxílio Educação e Idiomas; Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR); Previdência Privada; Seguro de Vida em Grupo; Reembolsos em medicamentos; Wellhub; Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendida, entre outros.

SOBRE A VAGA: Como Analista de Serviços com foco em custos você será responsável por otimizar os custos de manutenção através de análises aprofundadas de consumo de materiais, estratégias de suprimentos e avaliação de viabilidade econômica. Atuará como peça-chave na identificação de oportunidades de redução de custos, apoiando negociações comerciais com dados técnicos robustos e desenvolvendo estratégias que equilibrem eficiência operacional e sustentabilidade financeira. Seu trabalho será essencial para maximizar o retorno sobre investimento em manutenção, garantir competitividade e fornecer insights estratégicos para a tomada de decisão da liderança. PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES: Analisar consumo de peças e materiais por cliente/frota, identificando padrões, desvios e oportunidades de otimização; Identificar e quantificar oportunidades de redução de custos em manutenção, propondo ações estruturadas e mensuráveis; Avaliar estratégias de compra (spot vs. contrato) e recomendar a melhor abordagem com base em análise de risco e custo-benefício; Realizar análises de make or buy para componentes críticos, considerando capacidade interna, qualidade e impacto financeiro; Acompanhar variações de preços de peças e serviços no mercado, antecipando impactos e propondo alternativas; Elaborar e manter atualizadas curvas ABC de materiais para priorização de esforços e gestão estratégica de estoque; Propor padronizações de componentes e peças para reduzir complexidade, custos de estoque e tempo de manutenção; Analisar políticas de garantias e reposição de fornecedores, assegurando aproveitamento máximo de benefícios contratuais; Apoiar negociações comerciais com fornecedores através de análises técnicas, benchmarking e dados de consumo; Realizar análise detalhada de custos de manutenção por veículo/frota, identificando outliers de consumo e investigando causas-raiz; Elaborar relatórios de TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) para suportar decisões de aquisição, renovação e gestão de frota; Avaliar viabilidade econômica de recondicionamento vs. substituição de componentes e equipamentos; Analisar e propor políticas de estoque de peças críticas, balanceando disponibilidade e custo de imobilização; Conduzir benchmarking de preços de peças e serviços para garantir competitividade e identificar gaps de mercado; Realizar análises de custo-benefício de diferentes estratégias de manutenção (preventiva, preditiva, corretiva); Fornecer suporte técnico na elaboração de orçamentos anuais de manutenção com base em histórico e projeções; Desenvolver, monitorar e apresentar indicadores de manutenção e custos (KPIs) para áreas internas e clientes. O QUE BUSCAMOS: Graduação completa em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas; Experiência sólida em gestão de custos, suprimentos, controladoria ou áreas financeiras com foco em análise de KPIs, sendo um diferencial a experiência prévia com gestão de frotas ou manutenção de ativos ; Sólido conhecimento em análise de custos e formação de preços ; Experiência em gestão de suprimentos e estratégias de sourcing; Domínio de ferramentas de análise financeira e metodologias de avaliação de investimentos; Excel avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, Power Query, modelagem financeira) e Power BI para construção de dashboards e relatórios gerenciais; Forte capacidade de análise financeira e pensamento analítico , com habilidade para transformar dados em insights acionáveis; Visão estratégica para conectar análises operacionais a objetivos de negócio; Habilidade de negociação e comunicação clara para interagir com fornecedores, clientes e áreas internas; Perfil orientado a resultados, com proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplas demandas simultaneamente. DIFERENCIAIS: Conhecimento em sistemas ERP e ferramentas de gestão de manutenção (SAP, TOTVS, etc.); Experiência com metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma); Certificações em gestão de custos, supply chain ou análise financeira; Vivência em ambientes B2B ou prestação de serviços de manutenção. descricao: We are looking for a highly experienced SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution (SD) Consultant to own two critical areas: full-cycle Variant Configuration (VC) and B2B EDI customer integration within SD.
